concepts: invariance, identity transformation, object detection, absence of triggers
description: In the input you will see a single smooth, medium-blue rectangle with rounded corners on a white background.  There are no indicator pixels or external marks around it—no triggers to initiate any change.  Following the principle that without applied change agents a static object remains in its original state,  reproduce the input exactly as the output (i.e. perform an identity transformation on the entire grid).
visual_elements: solid blue rectangle with rounded corners
rectangular shape is wider horizontally than it is tall
static_patterns: no visible texture or markings appear or disappear
dynamic_patterns: none—no movement, scaling, rotation, color change, or other transformation
core_principles: in absence of external forces or triggers, visual elements remain unchanged
Fundamental principle: without applied change agents, a static object will stay in its original state.
